svg.title: Plan a movie as a sequence of shots
svg.desc: A shot list describes what the camera should show. Making a plan and producing a video are separate steps. Idea. Say what the viewer should see first and what should change. Shots. Describe the subject and movement for each part of the clip. Check. Read the shots in order. Make sure they show the intended change on screen.
svg.text: Plan a movie as a sequence of shots
A shot list describes what the camera should show. Making a plan and
producing a video are separate steps.
Say what the viewer should see first and what should change.
Describe the subject and movement for each part of the clip.
Read the shots in order. Make sure they show the intended change on screen.
